title: Bounce Pass Gates
description: Partners bounce-pass through a narrow gate of two cones on the floor between them; the bounce must land inside the gate.

content.objective: Throw bounce passes that land in the right spot so they arrive at the receiver's waist.
content.setup: Partners five metres apart with two cones one metre apart at the two-thirds point.
content.organization: Pairs; count gates hit out of ten, then switch the gate to the other side.
instructions: Step toward the partner and push the ball down through the gate.
The ball must bounce between the cones.
The receiver catches at waist height with two hands.
After ten passes, move the gate to the other side and repeat.
Narrow the gate as accuracy improves.
coachingPoints: Bounce point about two-thirds of the way to the receiver.
Thumbs point down on the follow-through.
Receiver catches with hands low, fingers down.
commonMistakes: Bounce too close to the passer, so the ball arrives at the ankles.
Bounce too close to the receiver, so it pops up too high.
Pushing with one hand only and losing direction.
content.safety: Pairs spaced so a missed pass rolls into open space, not other pairs.
progressions: Receiver moves sideways; passer must lead them.
Add a defender's hand above the gate.
variations: One-hand bounce passes from the hip.
Bounce pass on the move between two moving partners.
successCriteria: 7 of 10 bounces land in the gate.
Ball arrives between the receiver's waist and knees.
content.gameApplication: Bounce passes beat high hands; their accuracy decides whether the cutter can catch and finish.
